headline: Katalyst works to recover Swift rescue spacecraft LINK
summary: The servicing craft is being stabilized before it can help lift NASA’s Swift telescope.
script: Katalyst Space is working to recover LINK, the spacecraft meant to rescue NASA’s Swift telescope. Engineers are trying to stabilize the servicing craft before it can rendezvous and raise Swift’s orbit.
imageAlt: NASA image of the Katalyst spacecraft in an integration facility.
imageAltTwo: NASA illustration of the Swift space observatory in orbit.
